[P2] Capture interruption before attempting forced shutdown

When `awaitTermination()` throws `InterruptedException` and `shutdownNow()` subsequently throws, this catch exits before creating the lifecycle failure containing the interruption. Although the interrupt flag is restored, the original exception is absent from the caller's diagnostic graph. Capture the interruption failure before invoking `shutdownNow()`, then aggregate any fallback failure while preserving fatal precedence. Extend the existing `INTERRUPTED_FALLBACK` regression to assert that both exceptions remain reachable.
